text: Regulatory approval is based upon the final EIS. Project has received a permit to construct and operate, usually accommodated to any conditions that must be met and the market rate authority. From this point, the project must still obtain Section 401 permits, coastal zone clearance, Clean Air and Water Act permits, and state approval; often Approved and Under these permits are pursued concurrently with the FERC permit process but are also contingent upon the EIS. Project has commenced actual Construction construction; site preparation does not qualify. Facility must file monthly reports offering a summary of activity, status of outstanding permits, current project schedule, and compliance with environmental conditions outlined in the approval document. Completed Project has reached commercial operation.
